# lightdash_user_attribute (Data Source)

Reads a Lightdash user attribute of the organization by its name, including its `attribute_defaults` and the values assigned to groups. Use it to refer to a user attribute that this configuration does not manage.

The name must match exactly one user attribute. The data source fails when no user attribute has the name, and when more than one has it. It does not return values assigned to individual users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lightdash_user_attribute" "region" {
  name = "region"
}

output "region_user_attribute_uuid" {
  value = data.lightdash_user_attribute.region.user_attribute_uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the user attribute to look up.

### Read-Only

- `attribute_defaults` (Set of String) The default values of the user attribute. It is null when there are none.
- `description` (String) The description of the user attribute.
- `groups` (Attributes Set) The values of the user attribute assigned to groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) The data source identifier. It is computed as `organizations/<organization_uuid>/user-attributes/<user_attribute_uuid>`.
- `organization_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Lightdash organization that the user attribute belongs to.
- `user_attribute_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Lightdash user attribute.

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `group_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Lightdash group.
- `values` (Set of String) The values of the user attribute for the group.
